fullText: Automotive News – November 2026 JAC T9 PHEV Petrol Debuts in Malaysia as the Country’s First Plug-In Hybrid Pickup, From RM154,888 Evolvelectric Motors Sdn Bhd, the official distributor of JAC pickup trucks in Malaysia, unveiled in Kuala Lumpur on 11 November 2026 the JAC T9 Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle (PHEV) Petrol, which it describes as Malaysia’s first locally assembled plug-in hybrid pickup truck. The company claims that it is currently the only PHEV pickup available in the country. Evolvelectric Motors is the sole distributor of JAC pickup trucks in Malaysia. JAC Motors, founded in 1964, is an automobile manufacturer that integrates research, development, production and sales of commercial vehicles, passenger cars and new energy vehicles (NEVs). It serves personal and commercial customers in more than 130 countries and regions. The customer-oriented variant is priced at RM154,888. The exclusive ADVENTURE variant, which adds upgraded all-terrain tyres and distinctive black alloy rims, is priced at RM162,888. Both prices exclude road tax and insurance. The JAC T9 PHEV Petrol combines the versatility of a 4×4 pickup with electrified performance and long-distance driving capability. It is powered by a 2.0-litre turbocharged petrol engine paired with an electric four-wheel-drive (4WD) dual-motor system and a 4DHT hybrid transmission. The powertrain delivers a combined system output of 360kW and 1,000Nm of torque. The front motor produces 130kW and 300Nm, while the rear motor delivers 150kW and 340Nm, providing responsive performance and enhanced traction across a variety of driving conditions. Energy is stored in a 31.2kWh lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery supplied by Gotion High-Tech, operating at a rated voltage of 359.1V. The battery is designed to support both electric driving and long-distance travel, and offers an all-electric driving range of up to 100km on the New European Driving Cycle (NEDC). Evolvelectric Motors also cites a claimed fuel consumption of 1.6 litres per 100km, which suggests the potential to reduce fuel use when the vehicle is driven under suitable conditions. For charging, the truck supports both DC fast charging and AC charging. DC charging takes approximately 30 minutes to charge the battery from 15% to 80%. AC charging takes between 3.5 and 5.5 hours over the same range, depending on the charging equipment and conditions. Evolvelectric Motors Chief Executive Officer Lau Yit Mun said the T9 PHEV Petrol combines performance, versatility and value, and suits customers who need a vehicle for both business and family use. He highlighted the truck’s Vehicle-to-Load (V2L) function: “The JAC T9 PHEV is more than just a pickup truck. Its Vehicle-to-Load (V2L) function offers a discharge capacity of up to 15kW, enabling it to double as a mobile power station, allowing owners to power electrical appliances and tools wherever their adventures take them. Whether for work or leisure, the T9 PHEV offers the flexibility and convenience to go further, anytime, anywhere.” Evolvelectric Motors Chief Executive Officer Lau Yit MunBuilt on JAC’s third-generation international platform, the T9 PHEV Petrol is engineered to balance performance, capability and comfort. It has a braked towing capacity of up to 3,500kg and a wading depth of 550mm, keeping the practicality expected of a capable pickup truck while adding the benefits of electrified driving. Drivers can choose from three drive modes (Eco, Standard and Sport) and five terrain modes (Snow, Sand, Mud, Rock and Off-road Cruise), allowing the vehicle’s performance to be adapted to different road surfaces and driving requirements. On safety, the vehicle carries Advanced Driver-Assistance System (ADAS) 2.0. Its features include Adaptive Cruise Control, Traffic Jam Assist, Automatic Emergency Braking, Blind Spot Detection, Speed Limit Assistant, Door Opening Warning, a Driver Monitoring System, a 360-degree Around View Monitor and Transparent Chassis View. According to Evolvelectric Motors, the model has also received a five-star rating from the Australasian New Car Assessment Program (ANCAP). Inside, the cabin features black leather seats with diamond stitching. The truck is available in five exterior colours: Blue, White, Silver, Dark Grey and Black. Warranty coverage is eight years or 150,000km for the EV battery, and seven years or 150,000km for the vehicle. For many Malaysian households and small businesses, one pickup has to do the work of two vehicles: the weekday commute and job runs, then the weekend getaway. The T9 PHEV Petrol is built for that mix, and its main appeal is flexibility. On the daily drive, the claimed 100km electric range (NEDC) can cover many short commutes and errands on electricity alone. Test-cycle figures are an indication rather than a guarantee, and real-world results will vary with load, terrain and driving style. Owners who can charge at home can top up on AC overnight, as the 3.5 to 5.5 hours quoted fits comfortably within a night. When a longer trip is planned, the petrol engine means the journey doesn’t depend on finding a charger along the way. DC fast charging, at roughly 30 minutes from 15% to 80%, helps when time is short. The 15kW V2L function adds everyday usefulness beyond driving. It can run power tools on a job site or appliances at a campsite or outdoor gathering. For small business owners and weekend adventurers alike, a truck that doubles as a power source may mean one less piece of equipment to carry. On capability, the 3,500kg braked towing capacity suits boats, trailers and work equipment. The five terrain modes and the 550mm wading depth are there for those who venture off paved roads. The ADAS 2.0 suite offers extra support on long highway drives and in slow-moving traffic, while the 360-degree view and Transparent Chassis View can make tight car parks and rough tracks easier to manage. On price, the T9 PHEV Petrol starts at RM154,888, with the ADVENTURE variant at RM162,888. Buyers should note that both figures exclude road tax and insurance. The eight-year or 150,000km battery warranty gives some reassurance on the part of an electrified vehicle that buyers tend to ask about most. Photos by respective brands.
